blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Abbotsford total for houses that month.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Sumas Mountain?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 3 houses listed in Sumas Mountain. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Sumas Mountain a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses in Sumas Mountain had a sales ratio of 33% on only 3 listed, too few to read as a market type. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Sumas Mountain from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 1 houses sold in Sumas Mountain over those 5 months, out of 287 in all of Abbotsford.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Sumas Mountain?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.
